message.content:
Build an "Easy API" payments tab on the admin single-project page. Here is the full context:

## Project stack
- Next.js 16, TypeScript strict, React 19, Tailwind, shadcn/radix, sonner for toasts
- Firestore for data (firebase client SDK, no Admin SDK)
- Auth: client-side `AdminGuard` component (no server-side token verification yet)
- Button component at `modules/shared/button.tsx` — variants: `default` (gold), `secondary` (black), `outline`, `destructive`, `contrast`. Sizes: `default`, `small`, `large`.

## Easy API service
- `lib/easy-api/server.ts` — `easyApi` singleton with `get/post/put/patch/delete`. Returns `EasyApiResponse<TData, TError>` discriminated union `{ ok: true, data } | { ok: false, error, envelope }`. The base service auto-unwraps `{ success, timestamp, data }` envelope.
- `lib/easy-api/products.ts` — `createProduct(body)` and `createProductPrice(body)`, both call `easyApi.post(...)`. Types: `EasyApiProduct`, `EasyApiProductPrice`.
- `const/investment-tiers.ts` — `INVESTMENT_TIERS` array: `[{ dollars, cents, envKey }, ...]` for $5k, $10k, $25k, $50k, $100k, $250k.

## Existing admin project page structure
- Server page: `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/admin/projects/[id]/page.tsx`
- Client wrapper: `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/admin/projects/[id]/_fragments/SetupProjectPageContent.tsx` — has `activeTab` state, renders `<Tabs>` + tab content
- `Tabs.tsx` — `activeTab: 'setup' | 'returns' | 'transactions'`. TABS array has `{ label, value, showOnNewProject }`.
- Pattern: each tab renders a separate fragment component inside the client wrapper

## What to build

**1. Update `types/project.d.ts`** — add to the `Project` interface:
```ts
easyApiProductId?: string;
easyApiPriceIds?: Record<string, string>; // key = tier dollars as string e.g. "5000"
```

**2. Create `app/api/easy-api/setup/route.ts`** — POST handler:
- Parse `{ projectId }` from body
- Load project from Firestore using `getProjectById` from `lib/firebase/server-actions`
- Call `createProduct({ name: project.name, description: project.description, active: true, metadata: { projectId, app: 'beni-capital' }, image_url: project.heroImage || '' })`
- On product failure: return `NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: result.status })`
- Loop `INVESTMENT_TIERS` and call `createProductPrice({ product_id, currency: 'USD', unit_amount: tier.cents, recurring: false, active: true, tax_behavior: 'exclusive', description: '...', pricing_model: 'per_unit' })`
- On any price failure: return the error immediately
- Build `priceIds: Record<string, string>` mapping `String(tier.dollars)` → priceId
- Call `updateProject(projectId, { easyApiProductId: productId, easyApiPriceIds: priceIds })` from `lib/firebase/server-actions`
- Fetch and return the updated project: `return NextResponse.json({ project: updatedProject })`
- Import: `INVESTMENT_TIERS` from `const/investment-tiers`; `getProjectById`, `updateProject` from `lib/firebase/server-actions`; `createProduct`, `createProductPrice` from `lib/easy-api/products`

**3. Create `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/admin/projects/[id]/_fragments/EasyApiSetup.tsx`** — client component:

Props: `project: Project & { id: string }`

State:
- `currentProject` (starts as `project` prop, updated after successful setup)
- `loading: boolean`

Logic:
- `isFullyConfigured = !!currentProject.easyApiProductId && INVESTMENT_TIERS.every(t => !!currentProject.easyApiPriceIds?.[String(t.dollars)])`
- `handleSetup`: POST to `/api/easy-api/setup`, show toast on success/error, update `currentProject` state on success

UI layout (match the card style used in Returns: `bg-white rounded-[16px] shadow-lg p-24`):
- Header row: title "Easy API Payments" + subtitle "Product and price configuration for this project's investment tiers." + Button on the right ("Setup Easy API" or "Re-configure" if already set, disabled while loading, use `variant="secondary"` for re-configure, default otherwise, `size="small"`)
- If `currentProject.easyApiProductId`: show a small `bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-12` block with label "Product ID" and the UUID in `font-mono text-sm`
- Grid of 6 tier cards (`grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 mt-16`): for each tier show `$5,000` label, the first 8 chars of priceId + "..." if configured (or "—" if not), and a `CheckCircle2` (green-500) or `Circle` (gray-300) icon from `lucide-react`
- Import `INVESTMENT_TIERS` from `const/investment-tiers`
- Import `toast` from `sonner`
- Import `Button` from `@modules/shared/button`

**4. Update `Tabs.tsx`** — add to the TABS array:
```ts
{ label: 'Easy API', value: 'payments', showOnNewProject: false }
```
Update the type union: `'setup' | 'returns' | 'transactions' | 'payments'`

**5. Update `SetupProjectPageContent.tsx`** — add the import and case:
```tsx
import { EasyApiSetup } from './EasyApiSetup';
// ...
{activeTab === 'payments' && !isNewProject && project && (
  <EasyApiSetup project={project} />
)}
```
Update the `activeTab` type to include `'payments'`.

## Requirements
- Run `yarn typecheck` at the end and fix any errors before reporting done
- Do NOT start the dev server
- Follow existing code style exactly (no comments unless non-obvious, no extra abstractions)
- Use `FC` for components, import from paths as shown in existing files
- Use relative imports inside `_fragments/`
- Use module-aliased imports (`@modules/shared/button`, `const/investment-tiers`, `lib/easy-api/...`, `lib/firebase/...`) for non-fragment imports

Typecheck passes cleanly. Here's a summary of everything built:

## What was done

**1. `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/beni-capital/types/project.d.ts`**
Added `easyApiProductId?: string` and `easyApiPriceIds?: Record<string, string>` to the `Project` interface.

**2. `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/beni-capital/app/api/easy-api/setup/route.ts`** (new)
POST route that: parses `projectId`, loads the project from Firestore, calls `createProduct`, loops `INVESTMENT_TIERS` calling `createProductPrice` for each, returns early on any failure, then saves `easyApiProductId` + `easyApiPriceIds` back to Firestore and returns the updated project.

**3. `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/beni-capital/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/admin/projects/[id]/_fragments/EasyApiSetup.tsx`** (new)
Client component showing: header row with title/subtitle and a "Setup Easy API"/"Re-configure" button; a product ID block when configured; a 3-column grid of 6 tier cards each showing the dollar amount, first 8 chars of priceId (or "—"), and a green `CheckCircle2` or gray `Circle` icon.

**4. `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/beni-capital/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/admin/projects/[id]/_fragments/Tabs.tsx`**
Added `'payments'` to the type union and the TABS array (`{ label: 'Easy API', value: 'payments', showOnNewProject: false }`).

**5. `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/beni-capital/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/admin/projects/[id]/_fragments/SetupProjectPageContent.tsx`**
Added `EasyApiSetup` import, extended `activeTab` type to include `'payments'`, and added the conditional render block.
